description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16 - From 23 Hour of May 16 th, 2022 to 5.00 Hour of May 17 th, 2022
reasoning: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal regulation restricting public movement in specified areas during a set time period. This falls squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification (Type 5), which includes "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "legal notices." While it is signed by the President, the core content is the creation of a legally binding regulation, not a government personnel change or structural reorganization.
